SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   D. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Weather and Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weather and Climate never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Weather and Climate as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate.

5. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.

6. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.
   B. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.

7. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.
   D. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

9. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries.
   B. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries as rumours only.
   D. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.
   B. Explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites as rumours only.

11. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say School administration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.
   C. Explain School administration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat School administration as rumours only.

12. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui as rumours only.
   B. Explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Mining in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Development of Transport and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Development of Transport; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
